name: 青瓜田园清透平衡爽肤水款
description: 户外木长凳与点线账页体系的青瓜清透爽肤套图

styleLock.direction: harvest-bench botanical skincare commerce: a sunlit outdoor produce bench paired with a paper ingredient ledger
styleLock.backgroundSystem: two linked fields only: a weathered timber bench #6E4A2C set against a softly out-of-focus foliage wall #1E2B18 for the outdoor screens, and a dew-paper page #F2F7E9 with stacked pale leaf boards #E7EFDC for the ledger screens; deep ink-olive #2A3A22 is the only dark panel and it never carries a gradient
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm late-morning daylight at 5200K, one directional key entering from the upper left and skimming across every surface, long soft shadows laid to the right, bounce fill keeping the shadow area open, no hard specular hotspots and no blacked-out studio falloff
styleLock.surfaceSystem: weathered timber bench #6E4A2C with open grain, a striped raw linen runner, shallow unmarked glass saucers, and matte pale leaf boards #E7EFDC used as low risers
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif in ink-olive #2A3A22; layout devices are limited to vertical stacked label rails running down the side of the product and dot-leader ledger rows on the page; headline 28-40pt, label 10-14pt, never more than one headline per screen
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline monoline icons drawn in cucumber-rind #5C7A32 at a single weight with square terminals; hollow glass number beads are the only dimensional marker; no filled badges, no medals, no 3D glyphs
styleLock.presentationRules: the product stays upright, full-height and identically scaled with its label band facing camera; only one unit in the single-product screens and three units in the set screen; props stay below the shoulder line and never overlap the label band; liquid is rendered as a matte leaf-green gel pool #A8C24E rather than clear water
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #F2F7E9, #E7EFDC, #5C7A32, #2A3A22, #A8C24E, #6E4A2C, #1E2B18 and #C0862F
no mixed fonts, no script or handwritten lettering
no seamless studio sweeps, tiled walls, marble slabs or laboratory benches
no clear-water splashes, ripple rings, floating bubbles, ice cubes or aerosol mist
no medals, certificate scans, lab reports, clinical cross-sections or instrument read-outs
no model faces, hands or identifiable people
no invented numerals of any kind inside the frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: harvest-bench botanical skincare system held consistent across the entire image set; fixed palette of a dew-paper field #F2F7E9, pale leaf boards #E7EFDC, cucumber-rind green #5C7A32, ink-olive type #2A3A22 and one sun-honey accent #C0862F, with a weathered timber bench #6E4A2C and an out-of-focus foliage wall #1E2B18 reserved for the outdoor screens; warm late-morning daylight at 5200K with one directional key from the upper left skimming across every surface, long soft shadows to the right and open bounce in the shadow area, no hard speculars; one modern geometric sans-serif with vertical stacked label rails and dot-leader ledger rows as the only layout devices; hairline monoline icons in #5C7A32 only; matte leaf-green gel pools #A8C24E instead of clear water splash; the product stays upright, full-height and identically scaled with its label band facing camera; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no clear-water splashes or floating bubbles, no laboratory set dressing, no model faces.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：panel-01 为一瓶直立透明瓶放在户外风化木长凳上，右上方暖阳入射、背景虚化为绿色林木，瓶身四周漂浮五颗圆形气泡各带一条中文主张，凳面散放切好的青瓜片、两根整小黄瓜、薄荷叶与一朵黄花，下半屏转入浅薄荷绿纸面并给出产品信息框；panel-02 为六格肌肤状态照片墙（含可辨识人脸与唇部特写）配逐格中文说明，下方一行三个方框勾选符号，再接四行圆环图标竖排主张；panel-03 为瓶子立于无标透明玻璃浅碟、下压一条深色土面，右侧八行点线引导的中文参数表（品名、产地、规格、类型、保质期、功效、适合人群、成分），下方一条橄榄绿实心横幅标题与一张成分照片卡；panel-04 为两张成分照片卡（绒毛瓜蕾微距、蓝白泡沫微距）配整段中文说明，其下一条浅绿横幅标题、三枚玻璃质感数字珠 1/2/3 各接一条竖排中文标签，瓶子自绿色液体浪冠中升起；panel-05 为点线参数表加瓶子与绿色水花，右侧深绿实心横幅标题、一行大标题与一行副标题，下方 2x2 四张成分照片卡各带中文说明；panel-06 为浅绿横幅标题加斜体副标题、三枚玻璃数字珠竖排标签、瓶子在绿色浪冠中，下方再一组点线参数表与玻璃浅碟；panel-07 为浅橄榄横幅标题与 2x2 四张成分照片卡（藤篮青瓜、木碗橄榄、绒毛瓜蕾、蓝白泡沫），末段再来一条横幅标题；panel-08 为浅薄荷绿底、瓶子立于绿色浪冠中、三枚玻璃数字珠与竖排中文标签，左下一个黑色会员促销角标与一枚二维码。品类判定依据：源夹名「美妆」与文件名「润肤霜」均不成立——panel-03 与 panel-05 的参数表里「类型」一行写的是爽肤水，瓶身英文标为 ALCOHOL-FREE TONER，且 panel-03 与 panel-07 的正文多次针对面部皮肤与角质层表述；panel-02 的六格问题墙取的是面颊、额头、鼻翼、唇周与毛孔部位，全篇无任何躯干或四肢涂抹画面，也无婴幼儿、孕产或喂养线索，故判为护肤个护/面部护理而非身体护理或母婴；leaf 取「青瓜清透平衡爽肤水」，源页同时出现爽肤水与保湿乳两类，本模版按主产品（瓶身直立、占屏最多的那一款）归类。已剥离内容：源品牌中英文字标与徽章、创始人肖像图形、条码、原文案原句与竖排主张用词、六格中可辨识的模特面孔与唇部特写、气泡里的具体功效字样、参数表里的品名/产地/规格/保质期/功效/成分全部数值与名称、成分卡所点定的植物学名与百分比表述、二维码与会员促销角标、平台与店铺字样；所有数字与资质一律改为留空卡位或 {callout_n}，产品改为 {product} 占位。与近似模版的差异（库内 护肤个护/面部护理 段已登记 35 套，逐条比对 苔石冷雾草本点涂膏款、冷瓷滤光台防晒细雾款、男士草本大容量洁面款、泥感立方台清洁泥膜罐款、静置奶面硅胶刷头洁面乳款、植物水感清爽保湿乳液款、密集补水六件套水乳套装款）：一、色板全新且无一命中库内既有 hex，本套只用 #F2F7E9 / #E7EFDC / #5C7A32 / #2A3A22 / #6E4A2C / #1E2B18 / #C0862F，且 temperature 取 warm，而上述绿调近似件全部是 cool 或 neutral；二、背景体系是「户外风化木长凳 + 虚化林木墙」与「露水青纸账页」双场联动，库内近似件用的是标本纸格线、瓷质棚拍渐变、釉面方砖墙、陶白立方台、静置奶面与水彩植物底，均无实木台面与户外景深；三、道具语言换成收获叙事——藤编小篮、条纹原麻布、无标玻璃浅碟、切面小青瓜与深色土带，库内近似件的道具是苔藓石台、六边形刀卡、立方陶台、银杏叶、冰块与珍珠，一处不重；四、液体表现定为无水面波动的哑光叶绿凝胶池
